_note: PLACEHOLDER vocabulary built from slots computable from the normalized KUs. Replace with the ORKG-derived spec in the same format. Not Theorem A2 evidence. Context-determined constraints (field, paper type, a result's count of visible claims) and validity constraints (datatype, cardinality) are included on purpose: Theorem A2 says they cannot separate the degenerate branch.

slots.name: challenged
slots._def: the claim has real contradicting evidence (null statements like 'The paper does not present any contradicting evidence.' do not count)

slots.name: evidence_cites_figure
slots._def: the claim's evidence points at a figure / table / equation

constraints._why: evidence children are dropped when the claim is masked, so the context does not show it

slots.name: quantitative
slots._def: key_results reports numbers with units / percentages / decimals

constraints._caveat: claims' supporting evidence often restates result numbers, so this may be partly context-determined; check with the nuisance audit

constraints._why: the result grounds every claim of its paper and the claims stay visible: the context counts them

constraints._caveat: the procedure KU restates the method; use mask_policy '...+siblings' to hide it
